title: Emergency Supply Chain Management
scope_note: Section 4 (Procedure) steps 4.1-4.7.8 of SOP-09, in DOH Warehouse Operations Manual, 2nd Edition 2022 (data/corpus/DOH_WOM-Manual.pdf, manual pages 168-173 = PDF pages 174-179). This SOP has no contingency section and no process flow diagram. Steps 4.1-4.6 are standing requirements that carry no stated order between them; only the cross-docking sub-steps 4.7.1-4.7.8 form a sequence. Manual numbering skips 4.7.2. Step text is the Key Step column verbatim, with long bulleted detail lists summarised to their lead line. Verified against the source document by the author on 2026-09-17; see data/graphs/VERIFICATION.md.

steps.text: Ensure compliance with guidelines and policies for commodities that need to be handled under emergency supply chain
Perform the same routine activities and documentation during receiving, put-away, storage, pick & pack, and dispatch of health commodities for emergencies

For Donation during public health emergencies or disasters - before accepting donations, ensure that health commodities: are relevant for emergencies; registered for use in the country (except for those with emergency authorization); compliant with local and/or international standards; properly labelled in English; have at least 12 months shelf life; have just enough quantity for receiving to prevent overstocking and expiration; have been coordinated with and cleared by the health emergency management bureau, health programs or supply planning unit
steps.condition: donations are offered during public health emergencies or disasters

steps.text: For Emergency procurement: ensure to coordinate with the health emergency management bureau, health programs and supply planning unit to ensure availability of funds for logistics needed during emergencies and disasters; coordinate with them regarding procurement of needed health commodities, equipment, and related infrastructures in emergency cases
steps.condition: commodities are procured under emergency procurement

steps.text: Monitoring of Health Commodities for emergency: monitor the inventory of health commodities for emergencies within your warehouse as well as those warehouses and facilities under your jurisdiction
Coordinate with the health emergency management bureau, health programs and supply planning unit for the procurement/replenishment of standby logistics based on latest emergency criteria
steps.condition: commodities for emergency were consumed within the year

steps.text: Pre-positioning: the list of health commodities for emergency and volume of stocks to be stockpiled must be coordinated with health emergency management bureau, health programs and supply planning unit based on the latest guidelines/policies; stockpile health commodities in strategic locations for quick and ready access during emergencies

Cross docking: ensure that relevant officers are available for inspection of the items prior to distribution; coordinate with the health emergency management bureau, health programs and supply planning unit on the allocation list of items that will undergo cross-docking; coordinate with 3PL and/or in-house transport services to get ready for cross docking
Segregate items based on the allocation list and/or requisition order
Put a label to the stack for proper identification
Schedule the dispatch of the product
Maintain updating of stock keeping records
Counter check the documents, quantities and actual item during dispatch process. Ensure that relevant documents are stamped as received by the 3PL
Consolidate, countercheck and maintain carbon copies of Relevant Documents for filing and review of Supply Officer as necessary
